label: Purpose & Audience
raw_text: Explain how authors of texts use language for a specific purpose and a target audience.
child_texts: Identify the general purpose (e.g., to tell stories, to provide information, to share opinions, to explain ideas) and target audience in a variety of texts. (I)
Identify different modes of communication: print, digital, auditory, and visual. (I)
Create texts in teacher-selected modes (e.g., print, digital, auditory, and/or visual). (C)
competency_statement: Explain how authors use language to achieve a specific purpose and address a target audience, and create texts in various modes.
observable_behaviors: Identify the general purpose of a text, such as telling stories, providing information, sharing opinions, or explaining ideas.
Recognize the target audience for different texts.
Identify different modes of communication including print, digital, auditory, and visual.
Create texts using teacher-selected modes such as print, digital, auditory, or visual formats.
